title: fix(components): the record header star draws only where the host wires a toggle (objectui#12427)
body:
Fixes #12427
Clause-②: no

The card's last acceptance item, the remainder after PR #12443: the record header draws no favorite star. Shape = option A, as the contract review on PR #12443 (comment 6187751089, item ③) adopted it and the landing note 6188037096 restates it.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/components`, the `page:header` record chrome** (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`). `showStar` is now the authored flag AND the record context carrying `onToggleFavorite`. The chip's star is a control that stores something, so it draws only where a host wires one. Before, `RecordTitleChip` drew the star whenever `showStar` was not `false`; on a host with no toggle it flipped on its own local state and stored nothing. An authored `showStar: false` still hides it on a host that does wire one. The two `(ctx as any)` reads of `isFavorite` / `onToggleFavorite` became typed reads: `RecordContextValue` declares both.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`, `RecordDetailView`**. It no longer hands `RecordContextProvider` `isFavorite` / `onToggleFavorite`, so the console record page draws no star. Its favorites entry stays where PR #12443 put it: the `sys_favorite` item in the header's ⋯ overflow, ahead of Share. Nothing else in the file moved; the `synthParts` sections region that #12442 edits is untouched.
- **Docs**: the `showStar` row in `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` and the matching comment in `content/docs/guide/layout.md` now say the star draws only where the host wires a favorites toggle. This is outside the claim's file surface; it is here because objectui AGENTS.md #2 asks docs to follow the code. Drop it if the seat prefers.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/12427-record-header-star.md`: `@object-ui/components` minor, `@object-ui/app-shell` minor.

## Measurements (objectui `main` `a8e5b73`)

- **A1, held.** `showStar` read `schema.showStar` / `schema.properties.showStar` alone, and the chip received `onToggleFavorite` only when the context had one. Measured with the new pin on the unchanged base: with no context toggle, the header drew one star button (named `detail.addToFavorites` without an `I18nProvider`, "Add to favorites" with one). The two no-toggle cases went red and the three toggle cases stayed green.
- **A2, no published type member is removed.** `RecordDetailView`'s two props went to `RecordContextProvider`, not to the page renderer. `RecordDetailView` declares no `isFavorite` / `onToggleFavorite` props of its own. `RecordContextValue` in `@object-ui/react` keeps both members: they are how a host opts in, and `RecordContext.valueShape.pin` still lists them. `RecordTitleChipProps` (exported from `@object-ui/components`) is unchanged. So the line above is the claim's `Clause-②: no` with no narrowing arm. Nothing widens: no new export, prop or option.
- **A3, held.** After the change the console record page draws no star in either favorite state, and the overflow entry is its only favorites control (pinned below).
- **A4, the other hosts.** Every in-tree `RecordContextProvider`:
  - `RecordDetailView` (the console record page) was the only host that wired a toggle. It now draws no star, by design.
  - `PagePreview` (the metadata editor's record-page preview) wires none. It drew a star that stored nothing and now draws none.
  - plugin-detail's `recordBinding` wires none, but it wraps only `record:*` block bodies, never a `page:header`, so it draws no chip at all.
  - No in-tree host wires `onToggleFavorite` after this change. The CONTROL is therefore pinned in the components test, with a context that carries a toggle. A host of the published `@object-ui/components` that wires one keeps its star.

## Pins

- NEW `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-star-host-toggle-12427.test.tsx` (5): it uses the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry under an English `I18nProvider`, and every case first proves the chip row is drawn.
  - No context toggle: no star.
  - Favorite state but no toggle: no star.
  - CONTROL: a context toggle draws one star, "Add to favorites" with `aria-pressed` false, and pressing it calls the host once.
  - CONTROL: the star mirrors `isFavorite: true` ("Remove from favorites", `aria-pressed` true).
  - Authored `properties.showStar: false` with a toggle: no star.
- UPDATED deliberately: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.favoritesEntry-12427.test.tsx` gains "the record header draws no star, so the overflow entry is the one favorites control". With the chip drawn (its "Copy record ID" button present), no button is named Add to / Remove from favorites. The overflow's only favorites entry is "Add to favorites", and there is still no star after choosing it. The two existing cases are unchanged. No other test pinned the header star.

## Ablations

Both ran through `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, on the committed fix `cb68d1a`. The subjects resolve to `src/` through the root vitest alias table, so no `dist/` is on the path.

1. In `containers.tsx`, `!!ctx?.onToggleFavorite &&` became `true &&` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `04f5745` to `69a08ac`). The components pin went red on exactly the two no-toggle cases: 2 failed, 3 passed. Restored to the HEAD blob `04f5745`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
2. In `RecordDetailView.tsx`, the two props were re-added after `headerSystemActions={synthSystemActions}` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `b18512c` to `e3ec47c`). The record page pin went red on exactly the new case ("expected [ button ] to have a length of +0 but got 1"): 1 failed, 2 passed. Restored to the HEAD blob `b18512c`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The first attempt at this ablation was a no-op: its replacement contained the anchor, so the tool refused (anchor count 1 to 1), ran nothing and restored. It was re-anchored on the provider's closing bracket.

## Verification

- **Test union**, run from the repo root: `pnpm exec vitest run` over 167 files. The files are every test naming `page:header`, `RecordTitleChip` or `onToggleFavorite`, every `RecordDetailView*` suite, the `PagePreview*` suites, `packages/react/src/context/__tests__` and the console tests that mount `RecordDetailView`. The run printed `Test Files  167 passed (167)` and `Tests  3386 passed (3386)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The same union on `cb68d1a` before the merge printed the same counts.
- **Type-check** after building the console closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console...' --concurrency=2`, `Tasks: 35 successful, 35 total`, on `cb68d1a`):

  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` exited 0 on `cb68d1a` and again on `59c861e`.
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new components pin and the updated app-shell pin, one hit each.
- **`check:eager-closure`** on `cb68d1a`: "Console eager closure is 3079.2 KB gzipped across 69 of 2252 chunks (budget: 3119.4 KB, headroom: 40.2 KB)", exit 0.
- **Changeset gates** (`changeset-guard.yml`, `changeset-presence.yml`) all exited 0:
  - `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-overwrite` ("No pre-existing changeset was modified or deleted.").
  - `check-changeset-presence` ("4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)").
  - `check:changeset-claims` and `check:pending-changeset-literals`.

  - `check:doc-json` first exited 2 ("the strict authoring face is not built"), a missing prerequisite rather than a verdict. It exited 0 after the build.

## Acceptance notes

- `@objectstack/spec` describes `showStar` as "Show the follow (favourite) star beside the record title. Part of the record chrome — no effect when `recordChrome` is false." It does not mention the host-toggle condition this PR adds. This is a describe-text gap in the sister repo, noted here and not filed. Carrier: none.
- The maintainer accepts after merge (card thread: 「开发完了合并之后你验收」).
- #12442 edits a different region of `RecordDetailView.tsx`; this branch merged `origin/main` at `cf430cd` before opening, when #12442 was not yet on `main`. Whichever lands second merges `main` again, with a merge commit.
